query:
with links as (
                select id, notification_id, 0::int as recipient
                    from activity_push_notifications where activity_id = $1
                union all
                select id, notification_id, 1::int as recipient
                    from purchased_ticket_push_notifications where activity_id = $1
                union all
                select id, notification_id, 2::int as recipient
                    from purchased_ticket_push_notifications where activity_id = $1
            )
            select links.id as "id!", links.recipient as "recipient!",
                push_notifications.sender as "sender!: DIS",
                push_notifications.title as "title!: DIS",
                push_notifications.content as "content!: DIS",
                push_notifications.send_at, push_notifications.sent,
                coalesce(stats.n_sent, 0) as "n_sent!",
                coalesce(stats.n_opened, 0) as "n_opened!",
                coalesce(stats.n_dismissed, 0) as "n_dismissed!"
            from links
            inner join push_notifications on push_notifications.id = links.notification_id
            left join notification_stats stats on stats.notification_id = push_notifications.id
            order by push_notifications.send_at, links.id
